description: Append-only protection contract for repository-root files. Read by ops/scripts/validate_root_file_protection.py (the fail-closed CI gate). Review routing is registered separately in CODEOWNERS and ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml protected_paths. Every protected file is owner-reviewed via CODEOWNERS regardless of tier; the tier only decides whether the mechanical additive-only gate also applies.

rules.additive_only: Strict. A PR may only add lines. Any removal or in-place rewrite of an existing line (or whole-file deletion) fails the gate unless a matching justification marker is present in the PR's commit messages. Purely additive changes and brand-new files pass.
rules.managed: Human-edited operational file. Edits, overwrites, and deletions are allowed WITHOUT a justification marker, but the file is still routed to CODEOWNERS for human review. Not additive-locked.
rules.regenerable: Machine-generated artifact rewritten wholesale by tooling; exempt from the additive check. Still CODEOWNERS-reviewed.

justification.recorded_in: any commit message in the PR range (base..head)
justification.note: The marker authorizes the gate only; it never replaces human CODEOWNERS approval.

tiers.canonical: Governance, legal, dependency, gate/security, and environment-modifying surface. rule=additive_only.
tiers.managed: Living/operational/community docs and low-risk config. rule=managed (review-only).
